name: Card / Usage Summary
description: Usage Summary product scenario for the Card component.

props.title: API usage
props.content: 1.8M of 2M monthly tokens used across production agents.

controls.name: title
controls.description: Convenience title slot rendered through Card.Title and Face UI Text.

controls.name: description
controls.description: Convenience description slot rendered through Card.Description and Face UI Text.

controls.name: content
controls.description: Convenience body slot rendered through Card.Content; primitive values use Face UI Text.

controls.name: footer
controls.description: Convenience footer slot: text, React content, component descriptors or arrays. The JSON editor accepts every serializable form.

controls.name: variant
controls.description: Meaningful surface role: standard contained surface, unframed composition, or code canvas.

controls.name: padding
controls.description: Internal surface inset, from the standard 7px rhythm down to a flush composition.

controls.name: radius
controls.description: Corner geometry for contained, compact, dialog, or flush surfaces.

controls.name: border
controls.description: Draw the surface border independently of padding, radius and variant.

controls.name: hoverable
controls.description: Highlight the surface on hover or focus within; does not create an action.

controls.name: fullWidth
controls.description: Stretch to the available inline size. False uses intrinsic width and preserves parent alignment.

controls.name: footerAlign
controls.description: Alignment used by the convenience footer slot. Compound usage configures Card.Footer directly.

controls.name: children
controls.description: Compound children or custom content escape hatch.
